brief:
Yousef Jabareen, head of the Joint List, denounced what he called an "attempted coup" after media reports indicated that outgoing Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's office had attempted to frame members of the party, Middle East Eye reported. The accusation followed disclosures about efforts to implicate Joint List members in unspecified wrongdoing.

The Joint List is an alliance of Arab political parties in Israel. Jabareen's statement marked an escalation in tensions between Netanyahu and Arab-Israeli lawmakers, who have faced mounting pressure in recent years.
